rules.why: Cline 3.0.x's empty composer box (startup, after-turn and Plan placeholders) over its Plan/Act mode row, which sits at most two rows above the bottom. Quiet and no spinner above because Cline repaints the same box while a reply streams and its spinner row has scrolled away.

rows.regex: ^❯ (?:what can i do for you\?|ask anything\.\.\.|plan something\.\.\.)$

rules.why: A readable screen that is not the idle composer may be a picker, dialog or busy turn, which a name-only title or a quiet process cannot see.
